title: PAINT issue: GO:0030968	 endoplasmic reticulum unfolded protein response IBA with Q96Q80 , Q9GZP9 , S000002819 , Q9BUN8 , PTN000109990

author: ValWood
body: Its connection to UPR is indirect: like most ERAD genes, its transcription can be increased by the UPR when active, but that makes it a UPR target, not a UPR component.
